mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dialogue_turns ( turn_id, session_id, sequence_no, speaker, transcript, tts_text, tts_ssml, display_card, step, intent, extracted_slots, silence_ms, replay_count, interrupted, stt_confidence, input_type ) VALUES ( #{turnId, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{sessionId, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{sequenceNo}, #{speaker}, #{transcript, jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, #{ttsText, jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, #{ttsSsml, jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, #{displayCard, jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, #{step}, #{intent}, #{extractedSlots, jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, #{silenceMs}, #{replayCount}, #{interrupted}, #{sttConfidence}, #{inputType} )
mapper.select: SELECT turn_id, session_id, sequence_no, speaker, transcript, tts_text, tts_ssml, display_card, step, intent, extracted_slots, silence_ms, replay_count, interrupted, stt_confidence, input_type, created_at FROM dialogue_turns WHERE session_id = #{sessionId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND turn_id = #{turnId, jdbcType=CHAR}

SELECT turn_id, session_id, sequence_no, speaker, transcript, tts_text, tts_ssml, display_card, step, intent, extracted_slots, silence_ms, replay_count, interrupted, stt_confidence, input_type, created_at FROM dialogue_turns WHERE session_id = #{sessionId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND sequence_no = #{sequenceNo}

SELECT turn_id, session_id, sequence_no, speaker, transcript, tts_text, tts_ssml, display_card, step, intent, extracted_slots, silence_ms, replay_count, interrupted, stt_confidence, input_type, created_at FROM dialogue_turns WHERE session_id = #{sessionId, jdbcType=CHAR} ORDER BY sequence_no DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT turn_id, session_id, sequence_no, speaker, transcript, tts_text, tts_ssml, display_card, step, intent, extracted_slots, silence_ms, replay_count, interrupted, stt_confidence, input_type, created_at FROM dialogue_turns WHERE session_id = #{sessionId, jdbcType=CHAR} ORDER BY sequence_no DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT turn_id, session_id, sequence_no, speaker, transcript, tts_text, tts_ssml, display_card, step, intent, extracted_slots, silence_ms, replay_count, interrupted, stt_confidence, input_type, created_at FROM dialogue_turns WHERE session_id = #{sessionId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND speaker = 'AI' AND interrupted = FALSE AND step <> 'AWAITING_CONTINUATION' ORDER BY sequence_no DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT turn_id, session_id, sequence_no, speaker, transcript, tts_text, tts_ssml, display_card, step, intent, extracted_slots, silence_ms, replay_count, interrupted, stt_confidence, input_type, created_at FROM dialogue_turns WHERE session_id = #{sessionId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND speaker = 'AI' AND interrupted = FALSE ORDER BY sequence_no DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE dialogue_turns SET replay_count = replay_count + 1 WHERE turn_id = #{turnId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND speaker = 'AI' AND interrupted = FALSE
UPDATE dialogue_turns SET interrupted = TRUE WHERE turn_id = #{turnId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND speaker = 'AI' AND interrupted = FALSE
